'''Tefan''' was a King of [[Khodomar]].

== History ==
Tefan reigned as the King of Khodomar during the rise of [[Artur Hawkwing]]

In the summer of {{fy|943}}, Tefan moved his armies into [[Shandalle]] along with Queen [[Nesaline]] of [[Caembarin]] and First Counselor [[Almindhra]] of [[Tova]]. The reasons for this are unclear, but some sources speculate that it was due to a fear of a man who would not submit to [[White Tower]] law and who refused an audience with the [[Amyrlin Seat]], [[Bonwhin Meraighdin]].

Hawkwing fought back, and by the end of FY 943 he had conquered half of Tova, as well as large parts of Caembarin and Khodomar.{{ref/book|bwb|11}}
